runs.text: The Golan Heights: one hundred years in sixty seconds. nineteen twenty three. Britain and France draw a line. The Golan goes to Syria. nineteen forty nine. The armistice leaves Syria on the heights, above the Sea of Galilee. For years, both sides clash, and Syrian guns shell the farms below. nineteen sixty five. Syria starts diverting the Jordan's sources. Israel strikes the works. June nineteen sixty seven. In two days, Israel takes the Golan. nineteen seventy three. On Yom Kippur, Syrian tanks storm back in. Israel holds, then pushes them out. nineteen seventy four. Kissinger brokers a deal. Quneitra returns to Syria, and United Nations peacekeepers move in. nineteen eighty one. Israel applies its law there. The UN Security Council calls it null and void. two thousand. Talks with Syria come <<ˈ|k|l|oʊ|s>>, then collapse over the Sea of Galilee shore. twenty nineteen. America recognises Israeli sovereignty. Most of the world does not. December twenty twenty four. Assad falls, and Israeli troops enter the buffer zone. Syria calls it occupied land. Israel calls it a security frontier. Who's right? It all began with one line, drawn in nineteen twenty three.
